title: Google Sheets
description: Reads rows from, writes rows to, or looks up rows in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Google Sheets connection used to access the spreadsheet.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: What to do with the sheet range.

spreadsheetId.title: Spreadsheet ID
spreadsheetId.description: Identifier of the spreadsheet (the long id in its URL).

range.title: Range
range.description: Cell range in A1 notation (for example Sheet1!A1:C10).

values.title: Values
values.description: Rows to write. Required for append and update operations.

lookupColumn.title: Lookup column
lookupColumn.description: Column letter (for example B) whose cell must equal the lookup value. Used by lookup. It must lie inside the range.

lookupValue.title: Lookup value
lookupValue.description: Text, number or boolean to find (exact match with the cell's displayed text). Used by lookup.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum matching rows returned by lookup: 1 to 100, default 10.

valueInputOption.title: Value input option
valueInputOption.description: How append and update interpret values: RAW stores them as typed, USER_ENTERED parses them like typing in the sheet (formulas, dates). Default RAW.
